The design covers each of the five edit parameters with 20 experiments. Each block starts from a mid-band baseline (alpha 4.64e-06, batch 40, depth 2, learning rate 0.00167, width 101). From there I move the edited parameter itself, and each other parameter, to its low and high bands one at a time. The rest of each block pairs combinations where interactions are likely, such as learning rate with batch size, learning rate with depth, and alpha with width.
